capabilities: Create or register libraries from templates
Stage, diff and commit changes per library
Browse, search and compare commit history
Move or rename a library and update inbound links
disambiguation: Not an AI knowledge base or search index; it organizes vault folders into separate libraries with their own templates, checks and Git repositories.
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.15.1+); detailed guides are in Simplified Chinese; template-specific checks and the offline CLI need Node.js on the system PATH.
problem: Keeping several projects in one vault means they share one folder layout, one set of checks and one Git history, so changes cannot be committed per project.

relations.evidence: Its Git interface includes code adapted from Obsidian Git 2.43.0 under the MIT license.

summary: Sidebar manager that splits a vault into separate libraries, each with its own folder, templates, checks and Git history.
